# PHP Composer Manager Skill

**Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > PHP

## Purpose

Provides specialized knowledge, step-by-step procedures, and quality standards for PHP Composer Manager operations using PHP technology. This skill encapsulates technology-specific best practices, design patterns, performance optimization techniques, and production-grade implementation guidance for PHP within Backend development.

## When to Use

- When managing PHP project dependencies with Composer
- When configuring autoloading with PSR-4 standard
- When publishing private packages with Satis or Packagist
- When PHP-specific technical expertise is required
- When best practices for PHP technology stack must be applied
- When production-grade PHP implementation guidance is needed

## Capabilities

- Configure composer.json with proper constraints
- Set up PSR-4 autoloading for project namespaces
- Manage private packages with Satis
- Configure Composer scripts for automation
- Resolve version conflicts and dependency issues

## Procedure

1. Initialize or update composer.json
2. Configure autoloading for project structure
3. Manage dependency versions with constraints
4. Set up private repository if needed
5. Configure scripts for common tasks
6. Validate lock file consistency

## Anti-Hallucination Rules

- Do not edit composer.lock manually
- Verify package compatibility with target PHP version
- Do not fabricate version numbers, API endpoints, or library names
- Always cite the specific documentation, RFC, or standard being referenced
- If technology-specific data is unavailable, explicitly state the gap and request clarification
- Never assume features exist in a specific version without verification

## Quality Checks

- Lock file is committed and reproducible
- Autoloading follows PSR-4 standard
- No conflicting dependency versions
- All code examples must be syntactically valid and tested
- Cross-reference findings against official documentation
- Flag any assumptions made during analysis with explicit markers
- Validate all performance claims with reproducible benchmarks
- Ensure all recommendations follow PHP community best practices
